1. That the phone number is valid
2. That cellular service is enabled
3. That exactly 1 self-entry exists (to identify the sender)

That said, I bypassed the actual tool layer (since Python isn't available in this environment) and inserted the record directly into SQLite, so the tool's validation logic didn't actually execute.
